{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Essential Cooking Skills''''' was a [[Book/Legends|cookbook]]. One section of the book detailed how to best cook meat from large animals, including [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]], [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]], [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]], [[Gnort/Legends|gnort]], [[cu-pa]], [[Corellian butterfly]], [[torton]], [[Bageraset/Legends|bageraset]], [[Bearded jax/Legends|bearded jax]], [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko-peko]], and [[Veermok/Legends|veermok]].<ref name="SWG:ECS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|ESSENTIAL COOKING SKILLS}}</ref>
